summary: No shirt sponsor confirmed in a checkable text source for 2026/27. The club's kit launch (16 May 2026, with PRIMERA and the studio 'Nichego Obychnogo') names no shirt sponsor. The club site lists Gazprom dobycha Orenburg as general sponsor; match photos (2 Aug 2026, CC BY-SA 3.0 via fc-zenit.ru) show an 'eco gas' logo on the chest and Gazprom dobycha Orenburg on the shorts, but no named press article was found to cite either placement.
